mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.8% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE < 4.8% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index above its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5% signals improving supply capacity, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 12-month moving average by >1.5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA +1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls above 200,000 per month over three months signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above 200,000 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 200,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index above its 12-month moving average by more than 8% signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction sector earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 12-month moving average by >8%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 12-month MA +8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over three months together with a decline in nonfarm payrolls below 200,000 per month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.8% for three months AND PAYEMS falls below 200,000 for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.8% and PAYEMS < 200,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
